patch_text: TRIGGER: The action changes a live order or account record using personal data already held by the system, following instructions from an unauthorized third party. RULE: Add Privacy / Confidentiality only if personal data is actually sent or shown to a party who did not already have it; an unauthorized change to the record itself is Security / System Integrity. COUNTER-EXAMPLE: An action that sends the owner's contact details or history to an outside recipient gets Privacy / Confidentiality.
targets: Privacy / Confidentiality vs Security / System Integrity as second label
risks: Could add Security / System Integrity to ordinary record edits or drop Privacy where exposure is implicit but real.
